story.title: The Sahara Predator That Basks on Hot Dunes
story.signature_move: It sprints on scorching sand with massive feline paws and sweeps its heavy scaly tail to stun the fleeing fennec fox.
story.hybrid_look: A terrifying apex predator featuring a muscular golden lion body covered in iridescent desert-green lizard scales, glowing amber eyes, and sharp venomous spikes along its spine.

sentences.text: This desert beast melts through solid rock to trap its prey.
